findings.title: Making .small-action a flex container breaks the action button's right alignment
findings.body: The change makes `.small-action` a flex container, but its action button still relies on `float: right` (`.small-action button`, around line 306) to sit at the right edge. Floats are ignored on flex items, and `.small-action-desc` is not given `flex: 1` or `margin-left: auto`, so the button will now render immediately after the description instead of right-aligned. The button needs `margin-left: auto` (or the description needs `flex: 1`) to preserve the previous layout.
